checks: Cold initialization clears all 128 records and all 64 runtime bytes, then publishes disabled defaults; canaries intact.
LIVE, invalid admission, active, retained-source, held and outstanding-arena reset requests refuse before mutation.
All 128 independent pattern records round-trip natively with varied flags, lengths, masks, roots/scales and signed offsets; owner/cursors are not persisted; stock MIDI record untouched.
Out-of-range slots, stale save owner and invalid load owner refuse without mutation.
A single-byte corruption at each of the 32 record positions rejects without touching runtime state.
Saving and loading are explicitly quiescent-only, including outstanding descriptor ownership.
Full-width fields are checked before narrowing to the stored representation.
Publication retains the caller interrupt mask and flags.
limits: Explicit slot/owner APIs only; adapters to actual pattern publication, native save/load and copy/clear are not installed.
The byte sum detects simple corruption, not malicious edits or all multi-byte corruption.
RAM ownership and physical cache/timing for the enlarged region remain unverified.
